abstract: Two hundred and eighty-six patients presenting with metastatic adenocarcinoma or undifferentiated carcinoma whose primary site was not identified by clinical history, physical examination and chest radiograph have been studied. Median survival from presentation was 22 weeks. Factors independently predicting improved survival were lymph node presentations, good performance status and body weight loss of less than 10 per cent. In 88 (31 per cent) patients the primary tumour site was subsequently identified, in 58 (20 per cent) during life. Lung cancer was the most frequently identified primary tumour, and in only 32 (11 per cent) of the patients was a 'treatable' primary tumour (i.e. germ cell, breast, ovarian, prostate, thyroid cancer or lymphoma) identified. Among the treatable primary tumours were those in eight out of 16 female patients presenting with axillary metastases who were subsequently shown to have primary breast cancer and four of 13 females presenting with ascites who were found to have primary ovarian cancer. Prostatic cancer was confirmed in five out of 13 men with raised serum acid phosphatase. Of 22 patients with elevated serum alphafoetoprotein (AFP) or beta-human chorionic gonadotrophin levels (beta HCG) 18 had some features of the 'atypical teratoma syndrome'. Of the total of 32 patients with treatable tumour types, 29 (90 per cent) were identified during life. Median survival for patients with treatable tumour types identified during life was 104 weeks, compared with 22 weeks for the group as a whole. Retrospective immunocytochemical staining of the original biopsy showed that prostatic specific antigen and antibodies to beta HCG and AFP were diagnostically useful, but a series of organ site non-specific markers of histogenesis or cellular differentiation (carcinoembryonic antigen, secretory component for IgA, peanut lectin binding, epithelial membrane antigen and keratin) showed no significant correlations with identified primary sites, responsiveness to empirical chemotherapy or survival. Metastatic undifferentiated carcinoma or adenocarcinoma from an unknown primary site represents 6.5 per cent of all referrals to the medical oncology unit, Royal Prince Alfred Hospital, Sydney. We offer guidelines for the rapid identification of the limited number of primary sites for which effective and specific forms of systemic treatment are available.
abstract_ja: 原発部位が病歴、身体所見、胸部X線で特定されなかった転移性腺癌または未分化癌の286例を検討した。中央生存期間は初診から22週であった。生存期間の改善を独立して予測した因子は、リンパ節病変での初発、良好なPS、体重減少10%未満であった。88例（31%）では後に原発部位が同定され、58例（20%）は生存中に同定された。最も多く同定された原発腫瘍は肺癌であり、治療可能な原発腫瘍（すなわち胚細胞腫瘍、乳癌、卵巣癌、前立腺癌、甲状腺癌またはリンパ腫）が同定されたのは32例（11%）にすぎなかった。治療可能な原発腫瘍のうち、腋窩転移で発症した女性16例中8例は原発性乳癌と判明し、腹水で発症した女性13例中4例は原発性卵巣癌と判明した。血清酸性フォスファターゼ高値の男性13例中5例は前立腺癌と確認された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)またはβ-hCG高値の22例中18例は「非定型奇形腫症候群」の特徴の一部を有していた。治療可能な腫瘍型32例中29例（90%）は生存中に同定された。生存中に同定された治療可能な腫瘍型の中央生存期間は104週であり、全体では22週であった。後方視的な免疫細胞化学染色では、元の生検組織において前立腺特異抗原、およびβ-hCGとAFPに対する抗体が診断に有用であった。一方、臓器非特異的な組織発生・細胞分化マーカー（CEA、IgA分泌成分、ピーナッツレクチン結合性、上皮膜抗原、ケラチン）は、同定された原発部位、経験的化学療法への反応、生存期間との有意な相関を示さなかった。原発部位不明の転移性未分化癌または腺癌は、当施設の医療腫瘍学部門への紹介の6.5%を占める。われわれは、有効かつ特異的な全身療法が利用可能な原発部位を迅速に同定するための指針を提示する。
